kzudreti gaditA buDEH ॥ ataH sArdDamitAyAmA tadardDapariRAhinI । triBAgeRotTitA nOkA maDyameti pracakzyate ॥ kzudrATa maDyamA BImA capalA pawalABayA । dIrGA patrapuwA cEva garBarA manTarA taTA ॥ nOkAdaSakamityaktaM rAjahastEranukramam । ekEkavfdDEH sArdDESca vijAnIyAt dvayaM dbayam ॥ unnatiSca pravIRA ca hastAdardDAMSasammitA । atra BImABayA cEva garBarA cASuBapradA ॥ manTarAparato yAstu tAsAmevAmbuDO gatiH । tAsAM guRastu saMkzepAt dfQatA ca prakIrRatA ॥” aTa viSezaH । “dIrGA cEvonnatA ceti viSeze dbiviDA BidA ॥” tatra dIrGA yaTA, -- “rAjahastadbayAyAmA azwAMSapariRAhinI । nOkeyaM dIrGikA nAma daSANgenonnatApi ca ॥ dIrGikA taraRirlolA gatvarA gAminI tariH । jaNGAlA plAvinI cEva DAriRI veginI taTA ॥ rAjahastEkEkavfdDyA nOkAnAmAni vE daSa । unnatiH pariRAhaSca daSAzwAMSamitO kramAt ॥ atra lolA gAminI ca plAvinI duHKadA Bavet । lolAyA mAnamAraBya yAvadBavati gatvarA ॥ lolAyAH PalamADatte evaM sarvvAsu nirRayaH । veginyAH parato yA tu sA SivAyottarA yaTA ॥” Bojo'pi । “nOkAdIrGaM yaTecCaM syAttatratAni vivarjjayet । hastasaMKyA parityAjyA vasuvedagrahottare ॥ zazwyuttaramitA nOkA kulaM hanti balaM Danam । navateruttare yApi yA catvAriMSateH parA ॥ etena catvAriMSatizazwinavatisaMKyA tatparato'pi । yAvadaparadaSakaM tAvadeva tatPalamiti .” iti dIrGA । aTonnatA । “rAjahastadbayamitA tAvat prasaraRonnatA । iyamUrdDvABiDA nOkA kzemAya pfTivIBujAm ॥ UrdDvAnUrdDvA svarRamuKI garBiRI manTarA taTA । rAjahastEkEkavfdDyA nAma paYcatrayaM Bavet ॥ atrAnUrdDvA garBiRI ca ninditaM nAmayugmakam । manTarAyAH parA yAstu tAH SuBAya yaTodBavam ॥” Bojo'pi । “bARAgnyuttarato mAnaM nOkAnAmaSuBaM vahet । paYcASadUrdDAdullAsaM DananASaM trayordDvataH ॥” ityunnatA ॥ * ॥ “DAtvAdInAmato vakzyaM nirRayaM tarisaMSrayam । kanakaM rajataM tAmraM tritayaM vA yaTAkramam ॥ brahmAdiBiH parinyasya nOkAcitraRakarmmaRi । catuHSfNgA triSfNgABA dbiSfNgA cEkaSfNgiRI ॥ sitaraktApItanIlavarRAndadyAdyaTAkramam । keSarI mahizo nAgo dbirado vyAGna eva ca ॥ pakzI Beko manuzyaSca etezAM vadanAzwakam । nAvAM muKe parinyasya AdityAdidaSA BuvAm ॥ kalaso darpaRaScandrastrEdaSAnAM mahIBujAm । haMsaH kekI SukaH siMho gajo'hirvyAGrazawpadO ॥ AdityAdidaSAjAtanOkopari parinyaset ॥ * ॥ nOkAsu maRivinyAso vijYeyo navadaRqavat । muktAstavakEryuktA nOkA syAt sarvvato BadrA । tatsaMKyA cedaTa rasavedadvayasammitA kramaSaH ॥ kanakAdInAM mAlA jayamAleti gadyate sadBiH । brahmakzattre dbitaye ekEke vESyaSUdrayonI ॥ * ॥ nirgfhaM sagfhaM vATa tat sarvvaM dviviDaM Bavet । nirgfhaM pUrvvamuddizwaM sagfhARi yaTA SfRu ॥ sagfhA triviDA proktA sarvvamaDyAgramandirA । sarvvato mandiraM yatra sA jYeyA sarvvamandirA ॥ rAjYAM koSASvanArIRAM yAnamatra praSasyate । maDyato mandiraM yatra sA jYeyA maDyamandirA ॥ rAjYAM vilAsayAtrAdi varzAsu ca praSasyate । agrato mandiraM yatra sA jYeyA tvagramandirA ॥ cirapravAsayAtrAyAM raRe kAle GanAtyaye ॥ mandiramAnaM nOkAprasarata evArdDaBAgato nyUnam । Bojastu । dIrGavfttavasuzawdivAkarAnekadiNnavamitA yaTAkramam । rAjapaYcaBujasammitonnatirmandire tarigate mahIBujAm ॥ BAskarAdikadaSA BuvAM punarDAtunirRayanamatra navadaRqavat ॥ kAzWajaM DAtujaYceti mandiraM dbiviDaM Bavet । kAzWajaM suKasampattyE vilAse DAtujaM matam ॥ atra SayyAsanAdInAM manTarollocayorapi । anyezAYcEva muniBinirRayaH pUrvvavanmataH ॥ diNmAtramidamudizwaM nOkAlakzaRamagrajam । praDAnezveva niyamaH apraDAne na nirRayaH ॥ laGutA dfQatA cEva tasyEtAni vinaSyanti yaSo vIryyaM balaM Danam ॥” iti nizpadayAnoddeSe nOkAyAnam ॥ * ॥ jaGanyajalayAnAni yaTA, -- “nOkAnyato jale yAnaM jaGanyamiti gadyate । taddehA bahavaste tu pAScAtyAnAM
